'''Alikka Nolan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Hargeeva]] who served as the [[Arginall Refinery]]'s personnel supervisor, and a sympathizer for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], She was killed after being captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] while meeting with Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and former heir to the Hargeevan throne, [[Stevan Makintay]].<ref name="Firepower" />
